resources.string: Ferventio includes the runtime components below in the shared Android/iOS client. Test-only tools are excluded. Full license texts are bundled with the app and remain available offline.
The full license text is bundled with Ferventio and available without a network connection.
Shared UI, resources, and iOS Compose hosting infrastructure.
Kotlin runtime used by the shared Android and iOS client.
Structured concurrency, flows, and asynchronous runtime work.
JSON encoding and decoding for shared network and persistence contracts.
HTTP and WebSocket transport, including the Darwin engine on iOS.
Multiplatform image loading for avatars, badges, and emotes.
Kotlin Multiplatform bindings and rendering bridge used by Compose on iOS.
Native 2D graphics engine used by the Compose rendering stack.
